newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares stronger, focus on BPSM.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares stronger, focus on BPSM.

text.p: 1205 GMT - Portuguese shares opened firmer, with the focus on Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor, which rose more than three percent on optimism over the bank's first half results. Wood products group Sonae Industria, insurer Imperio and construction company Mota & Companhia hit highs. The Sonae group's Inparsa, which rose today to 3,550 escudos, later dropped back by 1.5 percent as investors took profits on the stock which surged last week on optimism it will win a bid to operate Portugal's third mobile phone licence.

* Dealers said they expected little change in the Portuguese share indices today, unless Wall Street has an impact at the opening. They said the optimistic mood on the bourse was linked to hopes for good six-month results as investors squared positions before the month-end.
